items.name: button
items.title: Sakuga Button
items.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-button>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Button is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/button.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-button>Confirm</sakuga-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: toggle
items.title: Sakuga Toggle
items.description: A switch whose flip is 43 painted frames: the knob smears across, slams into the end, throws up a splash, and the track floods and settles. The frames are inside the file (about 500 KB). One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toggle>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-toggle label="Notifications"></sakuga-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: slider

items.title: Sakuga Progress

items.name: badge
items.title: Sakuga Badge
items.description: A flat-ink status pill that sits plain at rest, bounces with a glint, wedges and a puff on status change or pop(), and shrinks away with chips when dismissed. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-badge>.
items.docs: Sakuga Badge is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/badge.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-badge tone="primary" dot>WebHID</sakuga-badge>. Call el.pop() or change tone to animate; add dismissible for a close button.
